info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1 - 101572409
info.description:
Secure Employee Management API. Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner works too).
Setup creates User A and User B; reruns are safe (409 is accepted there).
Tokens and employee ids are saved into collection variables automatically.

exec: pm.test("Server and DB are up", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(b.database).to.eql("connected"); });

item.name: 9. Rate limit demo (run separately)

request.description: Run this folder in the Collection Runner with 12 iterations (default: 10 failed logins per 15 minutes). The first attempts return 401, then 429 Too Many Requests with RateLimit and Retry-After headers. Restart the server to reset the counter.

item.description: Not part of a normal run: it uses up the login/signup limit for your IP.
